First, we recall the following formula:

$$
{x}^{2}+2ax+{a}^{2}=(x+a{)}^{2}
$$

Notice that we have a perfect square in the parentheses that we can factor as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+14x+49 & = \\ {x}^{2}+2\cdot 7x+{7}^{2} & = \\ (x+7{)}^{2} & \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}({x}^{2}+14x+49)+1 & = \\ (x+7{)}^{2}+1 & .\end{aligned}
$$
